officialReferences.label: Apple Set An App Age Rating
Apple Age Rating Values And Definitions

posture.statement: Kana Sprint is a language-learning matching game with no account, no user-generated content, no purchases, no chat, and no gambling.
posture.limitation: The final global and region-specific ratings must be saved in App Store Connect after answering the live questionnaire.

frequencyAnswers.label: Alcohol, tobacco, drug use, or references
frequencyAnswers.evidence: No alcohol, tobacco, or drug references are used in the study bank or gameplay.

frequencyAnswers.label: Contests
frequencyAnswers.evidence: No contest, sweepstakes, or prize competition mechanics exist.

frequencyAnswers.label: Simulated gambling
frequencyAnswers.evidence: Gameplay is answer matching only, with no gambling simulation.

frequencyAnswers.label: Horror or fear themes
frequencyAnswers.evidence: Original anime-style study lines are motivational language-learning prompts, not horror content.

frequencyAnswers.label: Mature or suggestive themes
frequencyAnswers.evidence: The app contains no mature, dating, or suggestive material.

frequencyAnswers.label: Medical or treatment information
frequencyAnswers.evidence: The app is a language-learning game and does not provide medical information.

frequencyAnswers.label: Profanity or crude humor
frequencyAnswers.evidence: Study content avoids profanity and crude humor.

frequencyAnswers.label: Graphic sexual content and nudity
frequencyAnswers.evidence: No graphic sexual content or nudity exists.

frequencyAnswers.label: Sexual content or nudity
frequencyAnswers.evidence: No sexual content or nudity exists.

frequencyAnswers.label: Cartoon or fantasy violence
frequencyAnswers.evidence: The app has hearts/lives for scoring, but no depicted violence.

frequencyAnswers.label: Prolonged graphic or sadistic realistic violence
frequencyAnswers.evidence: No graphic or sadistic violence exists.

capabilityAnswers.label: Gambling
capabilityAnswers.evidence: No real-money gambling or gambling services exist.

capabilityAnswers.label: Unrestricted web access
capabilityAnswers.evidence: The app opens fixed Support, Privacy, and Open source URLs only; it has no browser or arbitrary URL input.

capabilityAnswers.label: Made for Kids age band
capabilityAnswers.evidence: The app is not submitted in the Kids category.

capabilityAnswers.label: Override to higher age rating
capabilityAnswers.evidence: No higher rating override is selected locally; App Store Connect remains the final source.

capabilityAnswers.label: Korea age rating override
capabilityAnswers.evidence: No Korea-specific GRAC override is selected locally.

questionnaire.finalSource: App Store Connect age rating questionnaire
questionnaire.ageSuitabilityUrl: Optional public support or marketing URL after hosting site/.
